# tput

Query or expand a compiled terminal capability.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/tput -T xterm cup 2 3
```

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-T VALUE` | Use the specified terminal description. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

Supports boolean, numeric and byte-string capabilities, longname, clear and up to nine numeric parameters. Missing standard values retain ncurses status and output. Use -T for database dimensions. Live size, string parameters, terminal reinitialization and padding require additional terminal support.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
